content_sections.heading: UAS Dharwad Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AICWIP/ 329 / 2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download UAS Dharwad notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. (Agri) in Genetics and plant Breeding. The candidate should have 2 to 5 years of experience in Wheat DUS characterization Experience: 2 to 5 years of experience in Wheat DUS characterization Other conditions: Temporary appointment for 179 days or until project duration.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary engagement for 179 days, or till the end of the scheme, or until the government clarifies temporary appointments in schemes, whichever is earlier Being temporary, the appointment may be terminated at any time without giving reasons The appointment does not confer any right to a permanent appointment in the University Before joining, the appointed candidate must submit an undertaking on Rs. 100/- stamp paper in Format-TR-2

content_sections.heading: How Will UAS Dharwad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Direct interview If two or more candidates get equal marks in the interview, SC/ST candidates get preference for the temporary appointment

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form (annexure) in two copies All original documents of educational qualification Two bound sets of attested copies of documents Two photographs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application form given as the annexure of the notice, in two copies. Appear for the interview on 28-11-2026 at 11:00 AM at the office of the Associate Director of Research (HQ), University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad. Bring all original documents of qualification, two sets of copies, the annexure and two photographs. Do not send the application in advance under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The application must not be sent in advance under any circumstances Candidates attend the interview at their own expense Service in the University cannot be claimed as a right for a permanent post
